verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents fine-grained RBAC over its resources and says it can restrict production-environment changes to certain users, which covers the roles-and-permissions part of the story. Its Admin API can perform any dashboard action, but no evidence shows API tokens scoped to particular permissions or resources; the only key documented is the public, non-secret Environment Key. Missing for 10: scoped or role-bound API tokens, per-flag permission granularity, detail on role and permission definitions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
